description: This file defines an 'Action' class that interfaces with the Atspi library to perform and retrieve information about user interface actions such as click, press, release, menu, and open. It provides methods to get actions, perform actions, and retrieve descriptions, key bindings, and names of actions.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: A class representing an interface for user-actionable UI components, allowing retrieval and execution of actions such as click, press, release, menu, and open.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Retrieves all available actions for the UI component as an array of [name, description, keybinding].

methods.name: doAction
methods.description: Performs the action at the specified index; returns success or failure.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of the action at the specified index.

methods.name: getKeyBinding
methods.description: Gets the key binding associated with the action at the specified index.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the unlocalized name of the action at the specified index.

methods.name: getLocalizedName
methods.description: Gets the localized name of the action at the specified index.

methods.name: get_nActions
methods.description: Property that returns the number of actions supported by the object.
